items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, the same underlying model with Fable carrying strong cyber/biology safeguards for general availability. Outputs are up to 30% faster than 5.1 at lower pricing ($8/$40 per million tokens; optional fast mode at $16/$80). Prerelease testing included formalizing Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours, designing three electronic devices, and major coding migrations.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2，兩者為同一底層模型，Fable 帶有強化網路／生物安全防護供一般使用。輸出速度比 5.1 快最多 30%，價格降至每百萬 tokens $8/$40（可選快速模式 $16/$80）。預發布測試包含 30 小時形式化費馬最後定理證明、設計三款電子裝置及大型程式遷移。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Anthropic’s clearest push to claim leadership on hard technical and scientific work just as it starts IPO marketing. The dual Fable/Mythos access model continues its verification-program approach; real-world gains will depend on how reliably the advertised coding and research lifts hold up outside internal tests.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 在啟動 IPO 行銷之際，最明確宣稱在困難技術與科學工作上領先的一步。Fable／Mythos 雙軌存取模式延續其驗證計畫做法；實際成效取決於宣傳的程式與研究能力在內部測試外是否穩定。
items_flat.quote: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision. ... formalized the proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2 在程式設計、推理與視覺等方面有所提升。……在 30 小時內形式化了費馬最後定理的證明

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow at $70–78 per share
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 IPO 路演，定價區間 70–78 美元／股
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO of Class A common stock. The offering covers 825 million shares (most primary), with an expected price range of $70–78 per share and a Nasdaq listing under “ANT.” Underwriters receive a 30-day option for additional shares.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic, PBC 啟動擬議 Class A 普通股 IPO 路演。發行涵蓋 8.25 億股（大部分為公司發行），預期價格區間為每股 70–78 美元，並申請在 Nasdaq 以「ANT」代號上市。承銷商有 30 天額外購股選擇權。
items_flat.analysis_en: The formal roadshow confirms Anthropic is moving ahead with a public listing while shipping a major model upgrade. Valuation and demand will be tested against recent AI-sector volatility; the dual primary/secondary share structure is standard but the absolute size is large.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 正式路演確認 Anthropic 在推出重大模型升級的同時推進上市。估值與需求將接受近期 AI 板塊波動的考驗；主次發行結構屬常規，但絕對規模很大。
items_flat.quote: The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share. Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.”
items_flat.quote_zh: 首次公開發行價格預期介於每股 70.00 至 78.00 美元。Anthropic 已申請在 Nasdaq Global Select Market 以「ANT」代號上市其 Class A 普通股。

items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model. It improves dexterity, reliability and safety across 200+ tasks. In a Mercedes-Benz production proof-of-concept with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid, it achieved 96% success on automotive kitting. Success rates rose 30–100% and tasks completed 20–30% faster versus prior baselines; a new ASIMOV-Jailbreak benchmark was open-sourced.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布最強大的視覺-語言-動作模型 Gemini Robotics 2.5。它在 200+ 任務上提升靈巧度、可靠性與安全性。與 Apptronik Apollo 2 人形機器人在 Mercedes-Benz 產線的概念驗證中，汽車零件配料成功率達 96%。相較先前基準，成功率提升 30–100%，完成速度加快 20–30%；並開源新的 ASIMOV-Jailbreak 基準。
items_flat.analysis_en: The factory pilot is the most concrete real-world robotics result DeepMind has shown recently. Sustained high success outside controlled settings and broader partner adoption remain the open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 工廠試點是 DeepMind 近期最具體的真實世界機器人成果。在受控環境外能否維持高成功率，以及更廣泛的合作夥伴採用，仍是未解問題。
items_flat.quote: During a real-world proof-of-concept on Mercedes-Benz production lines, our models helped Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid pick and pack automotive parts with a 96% success rate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在 Mercedes-Benz 產線的真實世界概念驗證中，我們的模型幫助 Apptronik 的 Apollo 2 人形機器人以 96% 成功率撿取並包裝汽車零件。

items_flat.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon now available to developers and consumers
items_flat.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 開放給開發者與消費者
items_flat.summary_en: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available via API in AI Studio and Gemini for business at the same introductory price as Argon ($2/$10 per million tokens). It is rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity, the Gemini app and Search AI Mode. Carbon targets cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic work; Google highlighted top ranks on several independent benchmarks and new /swarm multi-agent features.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 透過 AI Studio 與 Gemini for business API 開放 Gemini 4 Carbon，導入價格與 Argon 相同（每百萬 tokens $2/$10）。它正推向 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者的 Antigravity、Gemini 應用程式與 Search AI Mode。Carbon 針對網路安全與長視野代理工作；Google 強調其在多項獨立基準排名領先，並推出 /swarm 多代理功能。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broad availability of Carbon expands Google’s frontier-model options beyond the earlier limited Fairwind cyber release. Pricing parity with Argon lowers the barrier, but sustained performance and cost on long agentic workloads will determine adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Carbon 的廣泛開放擴大了 Google 超越先前有限 Fairwind 網路安全版本的前沿模型選項。與 Argon 價格相同降低門檻，但長視野代理工作負載上的持續表現與成本將決定採用程度。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Carbon is available via the API in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business for all paying developers and enterprises, at the same introductory price as Gemini 4 Argon ($2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens).
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 現已透過 Google AI Studio 與 Gemini for business 的 API 提供給所有付費開發者與企業，導入價格與 Gemini 4 Argon 相同（每百萬輸入 tokens $2、輸出 $10）。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol code
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 正式驗證 Signal 協議程式碼
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agentic framework that formally verified key security properties of the actual compiled code of Signal’s libsignal implementation (including PQXDH and Triple Ratchet) down to machine-code level. The work generated millions of lines of Lean proofs in four weeks and is claimed as the first time a widely deployed protocol implementation has been formally verified at this depth.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code，一種代理框架，正式驗證了 Signal libsignal 實作（含 PQXDH 與 Triple Ratchet）實際編譯程式碼的關鍵安全屬性，下至機器碼層級。該工作在四週內產生數百萬行 Lean 證明，並宣稱是首次對廣泛部署的協議實作進行此深度正式驗證。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bridging design-level and implementation-level proofs for a real cryptographic library is a meaningful milestone. Scalability beyond this single protocol and the residual trusted specification base remain open questions for broader software assurance.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 為真實加密函式庫橋接設計層與實作層證明是有意義的里程碑。超越單一協議的可擴展性，以及剩餘的可信規範基礎，仍是更廣泛軟體保證的未解問題。
items_flat.quote: Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth. It's also the first time the implementation of a widely deployed protocol like this has been formally verified by any method, with or without AI.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的工作標誌著首次使用 AI 對廣泛部署的加密協議進行此深度正式驗證。這也是首次以任何方法（無論是否使用 AI）正式驗證此類廣泛部署協議的實作。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.8 pre-training done, soft Bot rollout later this week
items_flat.title_zh: Musk：Grok 4.8 預訓練完成，本週稍後對 Bot 用戶軟推出
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that xAI dumped JAX/SGLang and rewrote the RL and inference stack in C/C++. Pre-training for Grok 4.8 is finished, the model is now in RL with rising evals, and a soft rollout to Grok Bot users is planned later this week. He said 4.8 “will bear no resemblance to 4.7” and that the foundations are built correctly this time.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文表示 xAI 放棄 JAX/SGLang，以 C/C++ 重寫 RL 與推理堆疊。Grok 4.8 預訓練已完成，目前進入 RL 階段且評估分數上升，計畫本週稍後對 Grok Bot 用戶進行軟推出。他表示 4.8「將與 4.7 完全不同」，且這次基礎建得正確。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post is the clearest public status update on 4.8 to date and sets expectations for a limited Bot-first rollout. Until public benchmarks or broader access appear, claims about capability and the rewritten stack remain directional.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這則貼文是迄今對 4.8 最明確的公開狀態更新，並設定了 Bot 優先有限推出的預期。在公開基準或更廣泛存取出現前，關於能力與重寫堆疊的說法仍屬方向性。
items_flat.quote: We have dumped JAX/SGLang and rewritten the entire RL and inference stack from scratch in C/C++... Now, 4.8 is in RL and the evals are starting to climb. We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes. Grok 4.8 will bear no resemblance to 4.7 (thankfully).
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已放棄 JAX/SGLang，並以 C/C++ 從頭重寫整個 RL 與推理堆疊……現在 4.8 已進入 RL，評估分數開始上升。我們將本週稍後對 Bot 用戶進行軟推出，看看情況如何。Grok 4.8 將與 4.7 完全不同（幸好）。
